title: Business metrics scout record
description: One record per series the scout judged this run, reported or not, so precision can be measured as the share of filed reports a person keeps, and recall as the moves that went unreported. Subject is `metric:<name>:<measure column>:<period>`.

bm_record_version.description: Definition version. Charts filter on it, so bump it when a field's meaning changes.

bm_metric.description: The catalog metric name as metric-list returns it.

bm_measure.description: The measure column judged, because a metric with several numeric columns is several series.

bm_grain.description: The grain the lens ran at.

bm_period.description: Start of the judged period, ISO date.

bm_lens_verdict.description: Gate 2 outcome, or why the series was not scored: stale means gate 1 stopped it, out_of_scope means the scope rule did.

bm_value.description: The period's value as the lens read it; null when the series was not scored.

bm_expected.description: The step lens expectation for the period; null when the lens did not run.

bm_step_deviation_pct.description: Deviation of the value from the step expectation, in percent; null when the lens did not run.

bm_step_bar_pct.description: The step bar the lens applied, in percent.

bm_drift_deviation_pct.description: Drift deviation in percent; null when the drift lens did not run.

bm_drift_bar_pct.description: The drift bar the lens applied, in percent.

bm_seasonal_match.description: The same period a year earlier moved the same way; null when the window could not tell.

bm_driver_verdict.description: Gate 3 outcome from the script; offsetting when segments pulled both ways, not_run when gate 2 did not pass or the budget was spent.

bm_driver_dimension.description: The dimension that explained the move, when one did.

bm_driver_segments.description: The top segments, comma separated, when a driver was found.

bm_driver_share_pct.description: Share of the move the top segments carry, in percent.

bm_story_id.description: The story this finding was joined into, when gate 4 grouped it with others; the same id on every member. Its presence is what says the finding was joined.

bm_decision.description: What the run did with the finding; a member of a story carries the story's decision (authored or edited) plus bm_story_id.

bm_report_id.description: The inbox report authored or edited, when one was.
